site.name: Sourav Mondal
site.title: Sourav Mondal — Phase-Change Photonics, IIT Madras
site.description: PhD researcher at IIT Madras working on chalcogenide phase-change materials, active metasurfaces and reconfigurable nanophotonic devices. Research, publications, CV and personal writing.
site.intro: Exploring light–matter interactions and phase transitions for next-generation photonic devices. Curious about how materials work, and equally curious about life beyond the lab.
